title: Kulliyāt-i ʿUbayd Zākānī (Complete Works)
author: ʿUbayd Zākānī
notes: Complete Persian works incl. Risāla-yi dilgushā and Akhlāq al-Ashrāf. 14th c. Persian satirist.

title: Jou Pu Tuan: The Prayer Mat of Flesh
author: Li Yu; Richard Martin (trans.)
notes: Grove Press 1963 English translation. Standard scholarly edition of the Qing erotic novel.

title: The Golden Lotus (Jin Ping Mei)
author: Lanling Xiaoxiao Sheng; Clement Egerton (trans.)
notes: Egerton translation. Complete English edition of the Ming erotic novel.

title: The Nightless City, or, the History of the Yoshiwara Yūkwaku
author: J. E. De Becker
notes: Comprehensive English study of Yoshiwara pleasure district. Z. P. Maruya, Yokohama.

title: Metatheater and Sanskrit Drama: Mattavilāsa-prahasana and Bhagavadajjuka
author: Mahendravikrama Pallava; Bodhayana; Michael Lockwood and Vishnu Bhat (trans.)
notes: Bilingual Sanskrit/English. Two classic prahasana (Sanskrit farce) plays. 7th c. Pallava king.

title: The Perfumed Garden of the Cheikh Nefzaoui: A Manual of Arabian Erotology
author: ʿUmar ibn Muḥammad al-Nafzāwī; Richard F. Burton (trans.)
notes: Kama Shastra Society 1886. Burton's standard translation. North African erotic encyclopaedia.

title: Les Délices des coeurs (Nuzhat al-Albāb fīmā lā yūjad fī kitāb)
author: Aḥmad al-Tīfāshī; René Khawam (trans.)
notes: French translation of 13th c. Arabic erotic encyclopaedia. Contains chapters on 40 sexual types.
